personal.bio: Computer Engineering graduate from the University of Deusto, currently working as a Liferay Frontend Developer at Ayesa Digital, building corporate portals with React and TypeScript. Specialized in designing intuitive interfaces that meet client requirements. Proactive and results-driven, focused on code quality, continuous learning, and collaboration within multidisciplinary teams to deliver innovative, value-driven solutions.

about.title: Tech Stack
about.description: Technologies and tools I work with

bullets: Full-time role developing corporate portals with Liferay, React and TypeScript.
Design and implementation of intuitive, accessible interfaces that meet client-defined criteria and requirements.
Development of Client Extensions and reusable modular components to speed up feature delivery.
Close collaboration with design, backend and product teams applying Scrum to maximize quality and delivered value.
Development and implementation of pages and components on Liferay portals.
Creation of complex, modular features using Client Extensions built with React.js and JavaScript (ES6+).
Responsible for bug fixing and evolutionary maintenance of applications to ensure optimal performance.
Collaboration in multidisciplinary teams applying the agile Scrum methodology.
Research internship in next-edge for DeustoTech, within the DEUSTEK / MoreLAB team.
Worked on the Bachelor's Thesis: building a fuel price prediction model (TankGo project).
Designed a cloud-deployed microservices infrastructure exposed through a REST API.
Final GPA: 8.25 / 10, with a Bachelor's Thesis graded 9.9 / 10.
Highest Honors in Statistics, Databases I, Software Project Management, Software Process and Quality, Cloud Systems Architecture, and Advanced Web Data Application Development.
Project management: agile methodologies (Scrum), business models with Lean Canvas, and business case development.
Software quality: quality assurance processes and methodologies, verification and continuous improvement.
Databases: relational design and modeling (SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB).
Web development: Front-end (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React) and Back-end (Java, Python, C/C++).
Cloud architectures and infrastructure: containerization with Docker and cloud systems architecture design.
Information security: cybersecurity fundamentals and data protection best practices.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Featured applications and projects I've developed

tankgo.description: Cloud-native platform to compare real-time fuel prices, featuring an optimal-stop recommendation system for road trips, a voice agent, and 7-day price forecasting. Monorepo architecture deployed on Google Cloud.

studiotools.description: Web tool manager with customizable categories, three view modes and real-time search. Includes full authentication and cloud storage.

cityinsight.description: 🏆 1st Place, OA6 University of Deusto. Smart platform powered by generative AI to improve citizens' quality of life, detecting issues and offering quick solutions for local governments.

fintek.description: Personal finance app to manage accounts, transactions and budgets. Version 2.0 with Google OAuth sign-in (Supabase Auth), installable as a PWA.

waytro.description: Trip management app: itineraries, map, routes and planning in one place. Next.js with a Neon database.

bilbotrans.description: Real-time view of the Bilbao Metro, with Bizkaibus integration planned.

blogs.description: Personal blogs built with Astro and deployed on Netlify.

pinfluence.description: Full-featured Pinterest clone: photo browsing, downloads, favorites, advanced search and dark mode. Powered by the Unsplash API.

gasolineras.description: Check real-time fuel station prices across Spain. Includes sorting by price, station search and multiple filters to refine results.

galeria-arte.description: Web platform to explore art collections, paintings and artists. Includes a full management system built with Django and responsive design.

skin-care-routine.description: Web app to manage and track skincare routines. Lets users log products, track usage and get personalized recommendations.

competition.heading: Competitions & awards
competition.title: OA6 for University (3rd edition) · IBM Consulting
competition.organizer: Deusto phase winners and finalists · Feb - Jun 2025
competition.description: IBM Consulting's entrepreneurship and innovation initiative bringing together university talent from across Spain to tackle social challenges with generative AI and data. We won the University of Deusto phase (and the Liga Deusto) and took part in the national final presenting CityInsight: a tool that brings citizens' voices to city councils and offers real solutions based on generative AI and data. Months of teamwork with mentoring from IBM professionals (Lean Canvas, Business Case, Design Thinking).
